name: a3ref-mcp
description: MCP server for the Arma 3 scripting reference: search and read every SQF command, BIS_fnc function and concept page, and check SQF code for unknown, misused or deprecated commands.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/a3ref-mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
